vocab.gloss: bird; "bird" radical in Chinese characters (Kangxi radical 196); (dialect) to pay attention to

example.pinyin: Shù shàng yǒu hěn duō niǎo, zhēn hǎokàn.
example.gloss: There are a lot of birds in the tree — they're really pretty.

example.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān lán sè de xiézi.
example.gloss: I like blue shoes the most.

vocab.gloss: to take care of; to show consideration; to attend to

example.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò yào zhàogù wǒ mèimei.
example.gloss: I have to take care of my little sister this weekend.

example.hanzi: 我想多知道一點這裡的文化。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng duō zhīdào yìdiǎn zhèlǐ de wénhuà.
example.gloss: I want to learn a bit more about the culture here.

example.pinyin: Wǒ de jiǎo hěn téng, zǒu bú dòng le.
example.gloss: My foot really hurts; I can't walk anymore.

example.hanzi: 他昨天很奇怪，什麼都不說。
example.pinyin: Tā zuótiān hěn qíguài, shénme dōu bù shuō.
example.gloss: He was really strange yesterday; he didn't say anything.

grammar.title: 有點 + Adjective (a bit…)
grammar.explanation: 有點 means "a little / a bit" and goes before an adjective. It is used for things the speaker feels are not so good or not quite right, like 疼 (sore) or 奇怪 (strange). Note that 有點 comes BEFORE the adjective, and you cannot say 很有點.

examples.hanzi: 他最近有點奇怪，都不出門。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn yǒudiǎn qíguài, dōu bù chūmén.
examples.gloss: He's been a bit odd lately; he never goes out.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你看，那邊的鳥是藍色的耶！
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, nà biān de niǎo shì lán sè de yē!
dialogue.gloss: Look, that bird over there is blue!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 真的耶，好奇怪，我沒看過藍色的鳥。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhēnde yē, hǎo qíguài, wǒ méi kàn guò lán sè de niǎo.
dialogue.gloss: Wow, really — how strange, I've never seen a blue bird.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 這是我們這裡的鳥，我哥在照顧那些鳥。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen zhèlǐ de niǎo, wǒ gē zài zhàogù nàxiē niǎo.
dialogue.gloss: It's a local bird here; my older brother takes care of them.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.gloss: Taking care of birds isn't easy, right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 對啊，不過很有意思，也是一種文化喔。
dialogue.pinyin: Duì a, búguò hěn yǒu yìsi, yě shì yì zhǒng wénhuà ō.
dialogue.gloss: Yeah, but it's really interesting — it's a kind of culture too.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我們走很久了，我的腳有點疼，先坐一下吧。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu hěn jiǔ le, wǒ de jiǎo yǒudiǎn téng, xiān zuò yíxià ba.
dialogue.gloss: We've walked a long time; my feet hurt a bit, let's sit down first.

sentences.pinyin: Shù shàng yǒu hěn duō niǎo.
sentences.gloss: There are many birds in the tree.
I have to look after my little brother this weekend.
This matter is a bit strange.

sentences.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yì shuāng lán sè de xiézi.
sentences.gloss: She bought a pair of blue shoes.

example.hanzi: 這個禮物是我媽媽送我的。
example.pinyin: Zhè ge lǐwù shì wǒ māma sòng wǒ de.
example.gloss: This gift was given to me by my mom.
The weather in Tainan is very hot.

vocab.gloss: to raise; to increase; to improve

example.hanzi: 老師說我們要提高聽力。
example.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō wǒmen yào tígāo tīnglì.
example.gloss: The teacher says we need to improve our listening ability.

example.hanzi: 老闆對我的工作很滿意。
example.pinyin: Lǎobǎn duì wǒ de gōngzuò hěn mǎnyì.
example.gloss: The boss is very satisfied with my work.

example.hanzi: 我的腳踏車太舊了,該換新的了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de jiǎotàchē tài jiù le, gāi huàn xīn de le.
example.gloss: My bike is too old; it's time to get a new one.

example.hanzi: 那位司機開車開得又快又安全。
example.pinyin: Nà wèi sījī kāichē kāi de yòu kuài yòu ānquán.
example.gloss: That driver drives fast and safely.

grammar.title: 對……(很/不)滿意
grammar.pattern: A + 對 + B + 很/不太 + 滿意
grammar.explanation: 用「對……滿意」表示某人覺得某件事或某個東西很好。「對」後面放你評論的對象,「滿意」前面可以加「很」或「不太」。

examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè ge lǐwù hěn mǎnyì.
examples.gloss: I'm very pleased with this gift.

examples.hanzi: 他對那輛舊車不太滿意。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì nà liàng jiù chē bú tài mǎnyì.
examples.gloss: He isn't very satisfied with that old car.

examples.hanzi: 老闆對這位司機很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn duì zhè wèi sījī hěn mǎnyì.
examples.gloss: The boss is very satisfied with this driver.

grammar.title: 提高 + 名詞
grammar.pattern: 主語 + 想/要 + 提高 + (的) + 名詞
grammar.explanation: 「提高」後面接可以變好、變多的東西,例如程度、聽力。

examples.hanzi: 我想提高我的中文程度。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng tígāo wǒ de Zhōngwén chéngdù.
examples.gloss: I want to improve my Chinese level.

examples.hanzi: 多聽音樂可以提高聽力嗎?
examples.pinyin: Duō tīng yīnyuè kěyǐ tígāo tīnglì ma?
examples.gloss: Can listening to lots of music improve listening ability?

examples.hanzi: 老闆想提高大家的興趣。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn xiǎng tígāo dàjiā de xìngqù.
examples.gloss: The boss wants to raise everyone's interest.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 司機先生,請問到台南火車站要多久?
dialogue.pinyin: Sījī xiānshēng, qǐngwèn dào Táinán huǒchēzhàn yào duōjiǔ?
dialogue.gloss: Driver, how long does it take to get to Tainan Train Station?

dialogue.speaker: 司機
dialogue.hanzi: 二十分鐘就到了,今天路上很快。
dialogue.pinyin: Èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào le, jīntiān lùshàng hěn kuài.
dialogue.gloss: We'll be there in twenty minutes; the roads are clear today.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 好,我要去買禮物送我弟弟。
dialogue.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ yào qù mǎi lǐwù sòng wǒ dìdi.
dialogue.gloss: Great, I'm going to buy a gift for my younger brother.

dialogue.speaker: 小美
dialogue.hanzi: 他的腳踏車太舊了,可是新的太貴。
dialogue.pinyin: Tā de jiǎotàchē tài jiù le, kěshì xīn de tài guì.
dialogue.gloss: His bike is too old, but a new one is too expensive.

dialogue.speaker: 司機
dialogue.hanzi: 那買一雙新鞋吧,他一定很滿意喔!
dialogue.pinyin: Nà mǎi yì shuāng xīn xié ba, tā yídìng hěn mǎnyì o!
dialogue.gloss: Then buy him a pair of new shoes — he'll surely be pleased!

sentences.pinyin: Zhè ge lǐwù shì gěi nǐ de.

sentences.gloss: I want to improve my Chinese level.

example.gloss: That pair of yellow shoes looks really nice.

example.pinyin: Zhège tài zhòng le, kěyǐ bāngmáng yíxià ma?
example.gloss: This is too heavy — could you give me a hand?

example.hanzi: 我用電子郵件把照片寄給你。
example.pinyin: Wǒ yòng diànzǐ yóujiàn bǎ zhàopiàn jì gěi nǐ.

example.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei zhè cì kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn hǎo.
example.gloss: My younger sister's grades on this test were very good.

grammar.title: 對……（很）有興趣 — to be interested in something
grammar.pattern: Subject + 對 + Noun/Verb phrase + (很)有興趣 / 沒有興趣
grammar.explanation: To say what you are interested in, use 對 to introduce the thing, then 有興趣 at the end. Add 很 for emphasis, or use 沒有興趣 for the negative. The question form is 對……有興趣嗎？

examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì yīnyuè hěn yǒu xìngqù.
Tā duì dǎ lánqiú méiyǒu xìngqù.
examples.gloss: He isn't interested in playing basketball.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì xué Hànyǔ yǒu xìngqù ma?
examples.gloss: Are you interested in learning Chinese?

dialogue.speaker: 小安

dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhèxiē shì hěn yǒu xìngqù, suǒyǐ zuò de hěn kāixīn.
